workItem: Generalize observed active-PR build/test root causes into bounded PR autofix rules and project those rules into the read-only Control Panel fix algorithm.
workItemDE: Wiederkehrende Build-/Test-Root-Causes aktiver PRs als begrenzte PR-Autofix-Regeln verallgemeinern und diese Regeln in den read-only Control-Panel-Fixalgorithmus projizieren.
priorityReason: Stale repository projections and brittle work-graph expectations currently cause avoidable full CI failures across otherwise valid PRs.
boundaries: No test suppression or expectation rewriting to a new concrete slice number
Repository repair remains exact-signature/path allowlisted and generation-bound
Control Panel remains a read-only projection and gains no mutation or merge authority
exitGate: Observed PR build/test failures are repaired, deterministic recurring classes are safely classified/repairable, and the Control Panel projects the bounded finding-to-fix mapping from the canonical self-healing contract.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, close, supersession or abandonment.
